_comment: The exact model bytes this project measured against, and the only bytes
the extension build will accept. See ARCHITECTURE.md D46.
The revision is a git commit on the Hugging Face repo, which is
content-addressed, so pinning it pins the tree. The per-file SHA-256
digests are the part that actually protects the build: they were computed
from the local cache the M6 benchmark and every latency figure since were
taken against, so a fetch that verifies against them is checking the
download matches what was MEASURED, not merely what the repo serves today.
